defect: The stock Sessions overlay requested only catalog page 1 (pageSize 32). With 87 catalog rows the admitted Session was on page 3, so the row rendered with Open disabled and 'not discovered now'.

apps/chat/src/product-enrollment.js lists Sessions through readSessionCatalog, so manual Open stays bound to a selectionId the Host actually listed.

tests/product/session-catalog.test.ts proves the page-2 row becomes selectable only when listed; tests/product/restart-flow.py seeds 40 older native Sessions and proves the admitted row survives page 1.
